title: Let users relate a contact to multiple accounts
when: The step turns on or off 'Allow users to relate a contact to multiple accounts' (Contacts to Multiple Accounts) on the Account Settings page. It is not the Activity Setting about relating multiple contacts to a task, and not account teams.
steps: In the embedded Account Settings page, click 'Edit'.
Tick or untick 'Allow users to relate a contact to multiple accounts' as the step asks.

Turning it OFF deletes every indirect contact relationship. Salesforce asks you to tick 'Yes, I understand that this action permanently deletes data' and click 'Disable'; do that only when the step asks to turn it off.
doneWhen: Account Settings, no longer in edit mode, shows 'Allow users to relate a contact to multiple accounts' in the requested state (checked or not checked, read-only).

verified.outcome: Planned from scratch twelve times while the agent was being debugged, each run judged by retrieving Settings:Account. In the final form: on, 3 actions, 22 s; off, stopped before Save because the page warns of permanent data loss; off with --allow-destructive, 5 actions, 28 s, through the 'I understand' dialog. Metadata flipped each time, and the Setup Audit Trail recorded sharedContactsOffOn / sharedContactsOnOff. Turning it off is where Jev first declared DONE with the confirmation still open, which is why a reviewer exists.

notes: Browserforce covers this as relate-contact-to-multiple-accounts. Retrievable as AccountSettings.enableRelateContactToMultipleAccounts, which made it a useful test subject. Turning it off is destructive and needs --allow-destructive; turning it on does not.
